generated_evidence.quote_en: **Retrieval:** ACL filtering precedes generation text release; relevance never grants access. Form lexical/normalized vector queries, bound candidates, RRF merge, deterministic rerank, diversify documents/sources and cap model-context tokens. Parallel rebuilds atomically switch read alias only after completeness/recall checks; database remains authoritative. Cache keys include tenant, user-scope digest, source ACL revision, query hash and index generation. Permission change purges affected cache before TTL and next-query access remains mandatory. Insufficient quality/confidence returns `NO_SUPPORTED_EVIDENCE`, never fabricated context; clarification versus human route is unresolved.
